kickerAlternatives: MERGING TO MAIN, FAR FROM THE MAINLAND
profile.tagline: 👋 I build software and give most of it away: games, music apps, AI agent tools, smart-home integrations, Windows utilities, editor and browser extensions, and a few things for island life.

items.name: Boom Buds
items.label: GAME · PARTY
items.desc: Bomb-dropping party game for up to 10 players: on one screen, over the local network or online.

items.name: Pong Wars Reloaded
items.label: GAME · MULTIPLAYER
items.desc: Pong Wars, Day vs Night, reloaded with rackets, power-ups, AI opponents, board rotation and custom physics.

items.name: Escalier Score Keeper
items.label: CARD GAMES · OFFLINE
items.desc: Offline-first score keeper for Oh Hell (Escalier) with shareable game links, in several languages.

items.name: BoplFix
items.label: GAME MOD
items.desc: Bopl Battle mod: direct P2P connections instead of relays, and keybindings that stick.

items.name: Digital Circus Party App
items.label: PARTY · 3D · AI VOICE
items.desc: Self-hosted birthday party app with a 3D AI ringmaster, a cloned voice and iPad push-to-talk.

items.name: Sonora Live
items.label: MUSIC · WEBRTC · WEB MIDI
items.desc: Remote music lessons in the browser: P2P video, pure instrument audio and two-way MIDI between teacher and student pianos.

items.name: Note Master
items.label: MUSIC THEORY · SPACED REPETITION
items.desc: Learn to read piano notes on treble and bass clefs, with practice scheduled by the FSRS spaced-repetition algorithm.

items.name: Halloween Soundboard
items.label: PWA · SOUNDBOARD
items.desc: 260+ spooky sounds with a haunt mode, installable and working offline.

items.name: MIDI Notes Player
items.label: MUSIC · WEB AUDIO
items.desc: Sequence and play notes across 50+ instruments, right in the browser.

items.name: Perfect Bluetooth MIDI
items.label: WINDOWS · MIDI
items.desc: Bridge Bluetooth LE MIDI instruments into Windows MIDI Services, with stable reconnection and low latency.

items.name: Backspace
items.label: WINDOWS · ENCRYPTED BACKUP
items.desc: Set-and-forget encrypted backups to Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, S3 or local disks, with automated restore verification.

items.name: Photobox Book To PDF

items.name: Todoist Export
items.label: BACKUP

items.name: Trakt.tv Backup
items.label: BACKUP · POWERSHELL
items.desc: Back up your Trakt.tv watch history and ratings with one script.

items.name: Tidesight
items.label: WEB ANALYTICS · SELF-HOSTED

items.name: Cap Côtier Polynésie
items.label: BOAT LICENCE · FRENCH POLYNESIA

items.name: Phonestick

items.name: Chained Timers
items.label: PWA · ANDROID

items.name: WhatsPhone
